description:
FUSION GADGETS 1000ml stainless steel vacuum flask is a 1 litre hot and cold insulated bottle built for office, travel, road trips, and outdoor days. The double‑wall vacuum insulation helps keep tea and coffee hot up to 12 hours and water cold up to 24 hours, so you’re not stuck sipping lukewarm drinks halfway through your shift. A leak‑proof screw cap also doubles as a drinking cup—perfect for train rides, desk breaks, and chai stops without carrying an extra cup.

Made with food‑grade 304 stainless steel, it’s durable, reusable, and easy to trust for daily hydration. The wide mouth makes filling and cleaning simple and lets you add ice cubes with ease. The condensation‑resistant exterior keeps hands and bags dry, and the removable silicone wrist strap makes it easy to grab and go. If you want one reliable thermos flask that won’t spill, won’t sweat, and keeps temperature for hours, this is the everyday upgrade worth carrying.
